title: Extract fieldwork::actor module
description:
ActivityPub actor document serialization. ~170 lines duplicated across all three projects (server.rs + delivery.rs in each).

Source: BS server.rs:375-500 (cleanest separation), cross-ref GJ activitypub.rs for DID integration.

Public API:
- ActorDocument struct (or builder) with fields: username, domain, display_name, summary, public_key_pem, avatar_url, header_url, also_known_as, metadata_fields, followers_count, following_count, post_count, created_at
- build_actor_document(actor: &ActorDocument) -> serde_json::Value — construct AP Person object with:
  - Standard @context (including security, schema, toot, fep extensions)
  - inbox, outbox, followers, following, url URIs
  - endpoints.sharedInbox
  - publicKey block (id, owner, publicKeyPem)
  - alsoKnownAs array (DIDs)
  - icon/image for avatar/header
  - Mastodon-style PropertyValue attachments
- ap_context() -> serde_json::Value — cached standard AP context array

What stays in consumers: DB query to populate ActorDocument, route registration, content negotiation.

Deps: serde, serde_json.

Note: BS has simpler actor (no following), SH/GJ have full Mastodon-compatible actor. Use superset of all fields, make optional where needed.
